No network requests, file operations, or executable logic are present in `.SRCINFO`—it is a declarative metadata file. There is no evidence of obfuscated code, unauthorized downloads, or system modifications. All sources point to legitimate GitHub repositories related to the theme. Overall, this file adheres to standard AUR packaging practices and presents no signs of malicious activity.
